items.body:
I don't think there's a configuration available for your use case with in the spike arrest policy itself.

You should however be able to achieve your requirement using combination of developer app custom attributes and a step condition for the spike arrest policy(assuming your API is indeed secured using OAuth/verify API key policy).

For the clients that needs spike arrest policy by-passed, add a custom attribute say, ratelimit.skip = true in their respective developer apps. Assuming your verify API key policy is named verify-api-key, in your preflow, add the following condition to the spike arrest policy step.
<Condition>verifyapikey.verify-api-key.app.ratelimit.skip != true</Condition>

So your preflow should look like this -

<PreFlow name="PreFlow">
  <Request>
    <Step> 
      <Name>SpikeArrest.SpikeArrest</Name>
      <Condition>verifyapikey.verify-api-key.app.ratelimit.skip != true</Condition>
    </Step>
  </Request>
  <Response/>
</PreFlow>

This should skip the ratelimit check for the developer apps with custom attribute ratelimit.skip set to true and enforce it for all others.

If you are using OAuth policy, the variable names would change accordingly -
<Condition>app.ratelimit.skip != true</Condition>

References:

  1. https://docs.apigee.com/api-platform/reference/policies/verify-api-key-policy#flowvariables-appflowvariables
  2. https://docs.apigee.com/api-platform/reference/policies/oauthv2-policy#flowvariables
